concepts.name: 1 — Soft glass
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one polished, realistic website contact-modal design image, suitable to implement in HTML/CSS. Use the attached screenshot as the reference for Justin Bernard's existing website and its 3D brick church, sky and grass backdrop. Replace the old form with a newly designed contact modal. Keep the same recognizable church scene and front-facing camera angle around the modal, gently blur and dim the backdrop to make the form readable. Remove browser chrome and the old footer. A straight-on flat desktop website screenshot, no device mockup, no perspective skew, no collage. Landscape composition about 1536 x 1024; large complete centered modal, no cropped UI, generous surrounding background.
CRITICAL FORM REQUIREMENTS: Exactly six fields. Five required fields have permanent visible labels ABOVE their input, with a small RED asterisk immediately after the label text on the SAME LINE: "First Name *", "Last Name *", "Email *", "Subject *", "Message *". The optional sixth field is labeled exactly "Phone Number", with NO asterisk and NO "(Optional)" wording. Asterisks must be part of the label, never floating beside a field border. All labels left aligned; inputs empty and aligned to a consistent grid; the Message field is a generous multiline textarea. Use crisp legible type, correct spelling, and clear contrasts. The required stars remain red even when the surrounding theme uses other accents. The submit button text is exactly "Send message". Do not add extra fields, attachments, social sign-in, made-up contact information, trust badges, or decorative characters. Do not include concept numbers or explanatory annotations inside the website image.
Design direction: an elegant refinement of the current frosted glass form. A translucent milky-white panel, softly blurred church colors showing through, a thin luminous white border, rounded 24px corners, subtle soft shadow. High readability with dark slate labels. Centered title "Contact Me!" in an elegant lightly italic sans serif, in dark navy. A single subdued line beneath: "Tell me about your project." Spacious but compact. First Name and Last Name side by side, then Email full width, Phone Number full width, Subject full width, Message full width. White translucent input fills with restrained borders and rounded 10px corners; avoid the old heavy inset shadows. Full-width vivid blue button, subtly graduated from sky blue to royal blue. Aim for an airy, calm polished version of the existing site.

Design direction: highly readable minimal white contact card. Opaque warm-white surface, rounded 18px corners, a very subtle gray edge and soft shadow. Left-aligned bold dark-navy title "Let's talk." with small understated subtitle "Tell me about your project." Refined modern sans-serif typography, generous internal 40px padding. First Name and Last Name in two columns; Email and Phone Number in two columns in the next row; Subject full width; Message full width. Labels above each field, beautifully aligned. Pale gray field backgrounds with thin cool-gray borders, 8px corner radii. A full-width solid cobalt-blue "Send message" button with white lettering. Minimal and balanced, no decorative icons or ornamental gradients. The architecture remains recognizable in the softly defocused background.

Design direction: a wider, friendly two-panel contact modal with a cream-and-blue palette. Opaque ivory card, 22px rounded outer corners, soft shadow. The left third is a pale powder-blue introduction panel with a tiny muted-gold horizontal accent rule, large dark-navy serif text "Let's talk." and the short smaller line "Have a project in mind?" Plenty of breathing room. The right two thirds is an ivory form panel. First Name and Last Name in two equal columns, Email and Phone Number in two equal columns below, Subject full width, and Message full width. Every field has its exact visible label above it and red stars attached to the five required label texts. White fields with fine gray outlines and 8px corners. A full-width navy-blue "Send message" button at the bottom of the form. The design feels welcoming and professional, with clear separation between invitation and form, practical UI proportions and excellent text legibility. No illustrations or extra contact details in the introduction panel.
